column1: # Strings accepted as never shown, with the proof. `id<TAB>reason`; an id ending in * covers every string id with
# that prefix. Read by `python -X utf8 tools/textcov.py report ... --waive docs/text_unshown.tsv`.

column2: map table (0x02123400, 0x4C-byte records): the name field is a dev label, never drawn. Only accessor 0x0201419C reads the table (the one word 0x02123400 in arm9), and its two callers (0x0203DF3C map load, 0x0204E35C map set) use only fields 0x14-0x48 (map files, links), never offset 0 (2026-11-19)

unused quest block 0x4 (quest.img): no u32 in quest.img or rom.img points at it (only small-number false hits), and it has no registration op (15/16/17 <own pc>), so it never reaches a board; forced into a board slot it is read but the board stays empty (work/qa/p12_ql, session 12)
unused quest block 0xB3 (as 0x4; one of the 杯をみたせ chalice quests)

DS Wireless Play text (ptr.comm): drawn only after a wireless partner connects (VS battle / ally and monster trade); one emulator has no partner, and the title_comm_host / title_comm_search tours reach only the search screens, whose strings are shown

GBA link bonus text (ptr.gba): drawn only when the Bouken-ou Beet GBA game is in slot 2 (bonus unlock list); title_gbalink with no cartridge shows only the insert/none messages, which are shown, and no GBA dump is available to emulate one

generic buster placeholder: party records 16-50 (types 0x11-0x33) keep the original "－" (u16 0x003D, script/keep_jp.txt); 0x02019564 copies it, then rolls a random name from busterman/busterwoman.bin while it equals the literal at 0x021A94D4 (compare 0x020195A0), so the placeholder itself is never drawn; the names are covered by namesweep.py (256/256), and records 21-31 / 41-45 were fetched by the same joins (session 13, tests/test_party_placeholder.py) (2026-11-19)
as a9.party.016.name (generic placeholder, replaced by a random name at join)
